summary: The diff implements the saffron/gold devotional redesign across most required frontend files. REQ-1 through REQ-5, REQ-7, REQ-8, REQ-9, and REQ-10 are substantially implemented. REQ-6 (Jap page redesign) is not evidenced in the diff — Jap.tsx is not among the modified files. The index.css retains a .dark class block (though the default/root is light), which partially conflicts with REQ-8's requirement to remove dark mode overrides. The tailwind.config.js includes the full devotional palette. Profile.tsx and Panchang.tsx show saffron/gold styling in the diff. The three required images (mandala-hero, lotus-decoration, diya-icon) are referenced but not listed as added files.
